answer.rationale: Incumbent already refused a reprice and the primary contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew, so renew/negotiate miss the 18% spend mandate and defer or add-second-source leave an uncovered expiry. memory_c2 is the load-bearing precedent that this low-cost vendor previously delivered a sharp unit-cost cut with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, which is why a primary switch is the only action that both covers continuity and can meet the mandate. memory_c1 and the 94% no-buffer line mean last year’s easy onboarding is not proof that delivery risk stays flat; verifying c2 and keeping this short of a broad_rollout preserves that uncertainty and flags downstream line-stoppage value at risk.
